简介: Born in the Netherlands, Lana5 moved to the States to pursue acting when she was 18 months old. Since then she has worked in Los Angeles, Berlin, Paris and New York, but calls Charleston, South Carolina her home. A 52lb Belgian Malinois, Lana5 is the face of Anchor Pet Supply and when she's not modeling or acting she loves to swim and play ball at the beach. Her philosophy is "Get it".
